sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Updates the organization's security maturity assessment and roadmap based on progress and changes. Includes re-evaluation of capabilities, risks, and priorities. Aligns with business strategy and transformation goals. Supports continuous improvement and stakeholder engagement. Often conducted annually or after major changes.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Ensures relevance and alignment of security initiatives. Enables adaptive planning and investment. Enhances transparency and accountability. Supports strategic decision-making. Builds momentum and confidence in transformation.
